QF.id: AIFM Fee Structure and Fund Performance_52

question.text: Surya Infra Fund (Cat II) has committed capital of INR 500 crore and GNAV of INR 620 crore at end of Year 1. Management fee is 2% (excl. GST) on committed capital during the commitment period. GST at 18%. Total management fee charged to fund in Year 1 (incl. GST):

explanation.text: The Logic: Mgmt fee base = Committed Capital INR 500 crore during commitment period. 2% × 500 = INR 10 crore. Incl 18% GST: 10 × 1.18 = INR 11.80 crore. The Trap: Option B ignores GST. Option C uses 2% × 620 GNAV (wrong base). Option D uses 620 × 2% × 1.18 (wrong base + GST). Cross-Exam Context: XIX-A tests the commitment-based calc; XIX-C also adds post-commitment step-down. Manager's Pro-Tip: Explicitly state in the Contribution Agreement: base of fee (committed/invested/NAV), step-down date, and treatment of defaulted commitments. Ambiguity here causes 80% of LP-GP disputes in Cat I/II.
